description: Delete an assembly by opaque assembly_id, whether it is open or not. Requires confirm: true. One commit deletes assemblies/<id>.surf.json. delete_parts also deletes parts/<id>.js when no other assembly references that id. A never-saved open assembly is removed from the working copy only. Returns the assemblies that use its parts. Nothing is written until confirm: true. Takes return: "status" | "summary" | "full" (MCP default "status": status.script is omitted; "summary" adds status.features; "full" echoes the script).

assembly_id.description: Assembly surf-id. Not a name or path.

delete_parts.description: When true, the commit also deletes part files no other assembly references.

return.description: How much of status to return: "status" drops status.script, "summary" drops it and adds status.features (the feature strip), "full" keeps the whole script. Over MCP the default is "status"; in the page it is "full". Read the script with get_script.

name: delete_assembly
